name: The Usual, Please
storyline: Your uncle Joe ran the last burger cart on the pier. Then he drowned. Now the cart is yours, and so is the light. This autumn the fog came in thicker than ever. The ferry stopped, the coast road shut, and the people who died at sea started climbing up the ladders, wet and cold and hungry, walking to the only light left on the harbour. Yours. Cook for the town and watch for anyone who's dripping. Pull the alarm, and the masked men of the Harbour Watch come out of the fog to take them away. Everyone blames the fog. You have five nights to find out who really killed your uncle.
summary: A short horror cooking game. Run your dead uncle's burger cart on a foggy harbour pier in the 1970s. Cook for the locals, spot the drowned before they reach your window, and find out who really killed your uncle.
